items.claim: SLDS 2 exposes global styling hooks for system-level control of color, spacing, fonts, borders, and related visual properties.
Salesforce describes the Cosmos visual direction as simplified and modern, with increased spacing, intentional color and contrast, circular motifs, and legible typography.
SLDS 2 supports density and theme variation so a single enterprise system can adapt to different user preferences and working contexts.
The useful lesson is that a large enterprise system can add more visual personality only when semantic hooks and repeated workflow patterns remain stable.
